title: Uganda Lion:
title_q: “I Was Looking for Where to Belong”
headline: A Lion from Kampala went looking for where to belong, found a family, and his best friend is about to lead his club.
story: A Lion from Uganda in a blue embroidered shirt tells Atdhe that when he joined in 2016 he was looking for where to belong. In the Lions Club of Kampala Central he found a family of Lions. One of them became his best friend, and that friend is now going to be his club president.
The last quarter is his advice to a first-timer: talk to any Lion, they will receive you, and you will make friends from all over the world. Proud, joyful, friendship all the way through.
